items.name: ንግሁ ኢትዮጵያ (Dawn Ethiopia)
items.title: Dawn Ethiopia Morning Show
items.description: Wake up with Ethiopia's most popular morning show. Hosted by renowned journalist Meseret Mulugeta, featuring news analysis, interviews with policymakers, and cultural segments that celebrate Ethiopian heritage.
items.featured_episode: Interview with Prime Minister on Economic Reforms

items.name: WEFEN - Politics Unplugged
items.title: WEFEN: Political Analysis
items.description: In-depth political analysis and debate on Ethiopian and Horn of Africa affairs. The show brings together analysts, diplomats, and political figures for unfiltered discussion on regional dynamics.

items.name: Ye Ethiopia Lijoch (Ethiopian Children)
items.title: Children's Educational Program
items.description: Educational entertainment for Ethiopian children, featuring traditional stories, Amharic alphabet lessons, and interactive learning segments that connect young Ethiopians worldwide with their heritage.

items.name: Taste of Ethiopia
items.title: Culinary Journey
items.description: Explore the rich culinary traditions of Ethiopia. From traditional injera making to modern Ethiopian fusion cuisine, chef Selamawit Desta takes viewers on a gastronomic journey across the nation's diverse regions.

items.name: Ethio Music Countdown
items.title: Top Ethiopian Music Videos
items.description: The definitive weekly countdown of Ethiopia's hottest music videos. Hosted by popular DJ Mercy, featuring interviews with top artists, behind-the-scenes footage, and exclusive acoustic performances.

items.name: Business 360
items.title: Ethiopian Business & Economy
items.description: Comprehensive coverage of Ethiopia's business landscape. Features market analysis, interviews with CEOs, startup spotlights, and investment opportunities in Africa's fastest-growing economy.

items.name: Ethiopian Premier League Live
items.title: EPL Live Match Coverage
items.description: Live coverage and analysis of Ethiopian Premier League football matches. Pre-game analysis, live commentary, post-match interviews, and expert panel discussions on Ethiopian football.
items.featured_episode: Saint George vs Ethiopia Bunna Derby

items.name: Heritage: Ethiopian History
items.title: Documenting Ethiopian Civilization
items.description: Award-winning documentary series exploring Ethiopia's 3,000-year history. From the Axumite Empire to the Battle of Adwa, from Lalibela to Harar - uncovering the stories that shaped Ethiopian civilization.
items.featured_episode: The Lost Ark of the Covenant

items.name: Tech Ethiopia
items.title: Innovation & Technology
items.description: Exploring Ethiopia's growing tech ecosystem. Features on innovative startups, interviews with tech entrepreneurs, reviews of local apps, and discussions on digital transformation in Ethiopia.

items.name: Health Matters
items.title: Ethiopian Healthcare
items.description: Expert advice on health and wellness topics relevant to Ethiopians. Covers public health issues, traditional medicine, nutrition, mental health, and interviews with leading medical professionals.

items.name: Ethiopian Diaspora Hour
items.title: Connecting Ethiopians Worldwide
items.description: A show dedicated to the Ethiopian diaspora community. Features success stories, immigration advice, investment opportunities back home, and cultural connections for Ethiopians abroad.
items.featured_episode: Ethiopian Doctors in the USA Giving Back

items.name: Women of Ethiopia
items.title: Empowering Ethiopian Women
items.description: Celebrating Ethiopian women who are breaking barriers and making a difference. From entrepreneurs to artists, politicians to athletes - sharing stories of inspiration and achievement.

items.name: Environment Watch
items.title: Green Ethiopia Initiative
items.description: Coverage of environmental issues and the Green Legacy Initiative. Follows reforestation efforts, wildlife conservation, climate change impacts, and sustainable development projects across Ethiopia.

items.name: Youth Voice
items.title: Ethiopian Youth Perspectives
items.description: A platform for Ethiopian youth to discuss issues affecting their generation. Education, employment, creativity, and social change - hear the voices shaping Ethiopia's future.

items.name: Ethiopian Comedy Night
items.title: Stand-up & Sketch Comedy
items.description: Ethiopia's funniest comedians take the stage. Original sketch comedy, stand-up performances, and satirical takes on Ethiopian life, politics, and culture.
